blocks.text: Origin / creation. Era Three practitioners inherited chord fragments through lullabies, alarms, healing tones, work songs, battle calls, bodily tendencies, and responsive ruins.
Identity / human status. Cyber-pet and little-people traditions, not surviving Full Speakers.
Importance. They kept a usable connection to ancient language and infrastructure after complete ternary grammar and noun-role systems were lost.
Decline or degradation. The Dimming destroyed teachers, routes, bodies, and listening contexts. Traditions fragmented and identical sounds acquired different meanings.
Final status / surviving function. Survive only as scattered schools and local practices by late Era Three. Music, ruin access, warnings, and possible Era Four language recovery depend on them.
